summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on June 30, 2026, for a registered direct offering of 11,038,767 shares of Class A common stock at $0.165 per share, the same as the prior day's closing price, with no premium. The offering is done directly to investors without a placement agent or underwriter, so no underwriting discounts. The company relies on General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, selling up to $1.82 million based on public float. Delivery is on or about July 1, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
